cues.en: Hi, my name is Tony, and this is Every Frame a Painting. The first time I ever felt like a movie lied to me, I was eight years old, and it was Homeward Bound 2, lost in San Francisco. Because this isn't San Francisco. What's this? I thought we were going someplace cool. This is my favorite place in the entire city. This is Vancouver, where I grew up. If you watch enough TV shows or blockbusters, then chances are you've seen my city. Disguised as Santa Barbara? Or as Seattle?
cues.zh: 嗨，我是 Tony，这里是 Every Frame a Painting。我第一次觉得电影骗了我，是在八岁那年，那部电影是 Homeward Bound 2, lost in San Francisco。因为这根本不是旧金山。这是什么？我以为我们要去个很酷的地方。这是全城我最喜欢的地方。这里是温哥华，我长大的地方。如果你看够多的电视剧或大片，很可能早就见过我的城市。它伪装成圣巴巴拉？或者伪装成西雅图？

cues.en: And even one time is the Bronx. But no matter how many movies or TV shows are filmed here, there's always been one nagging problem. We never actually see the city. It's always pretending to be somewhere else.
cues.zh: 甚至有一次是 Bronx。但不管这里拍过多少电影或电视节目，始终有个烦人的问题：我们从没真正看到过这座城市。它总是在假装自己是别的地方。

cues.en: You are fucking stupid and you are fucking ignorant, Dave. Vancouver is actually the third biggest film city in North America. But we're so hidden, we even have movies about how we're not featured in the movies. My specialty is disguising Vancouver so it looks like an American city. But how do you fake one city as another without the audience noticing? Well first you need to know the city.
cues.zh: 你他妈真蠢，还他妈无知，Dave。Vancouver 其实是北美第三大电影拍摄城市。但我们太隐蔽了，甚至还有电影讲我们没在电影里出现。我的专长就是把 Vancouver 伪装成一座美国城市。但怎么在观众不察觉的情况下，把一座城市伪装成另一座？首先，你得了解这座城市。

cues.en: And Vancouver is kind of a chameleon. In Mission Impossible Ghost Protocol, it plays Seattle, and Eastern Europe, and even India, all within a 15 minute drive of each other. Once you know the city, it's actually pretty simple to trick the audience. Most people don't question the establishing shot, so you can just find the right building and put a title card on screen. The other option is to shoot second unit footage of another city, and then cut to somewhere in Vancouver. This is especially common with Seattle, since a lot of the architecture there
cues.zh: 温哥华有点像变色龙。在《Mission Impossible Ghost Protocol》里，它演过西雅图、东欧，甚至印度，而这些地方彼此之间只有15分钟车程。一旦了解这座城市，其实很容易骗过观众。大多数人不会质疑定场镜头，所以你只要找到合适的建筑，在画面上加个标题卡就行。另一种办法是拍另一个城市的第二摄制组素材，然后切到温哥华的某处。这在西雅图尤其常见，因为那里很多建筑

cues.en: Looks pretty similar to here. But to really convince the audience, you're gonna need a lot of help. Which brings us to the art department, who control all the little details. Like decals on the sides of cars, American flags in the background, new signs in front of buildings, and this one's my personal favorite. USA Today vending machines. Because nothing says America like USA Today.
cues.zh: 看起来和这里很像。但真要说服观众，你还需要很多帮助。这就说到美术部门了，他们掌控所有小细节。比如车侧的贴花、背景里的美国国旗、建筑前的新招牌，还有我个人最喜欢的一个。《USA Today》售报机。因为没有什么比《USA Today》更能代表美国了。

cues.en: The next step in faking a city is deciding how you're going to light and shoot it. One of the best ways to disguise Vancouver is to film at night in shallow focus. This is to avoid pulling a rumble in the Bronx when they pointed the camera north and you could clearly see the mountains. It's kind of remarkable what you can get from a location by changing the angle and the lighting.
cues.zh: 伪造一座城市的下一步，是决定怎么给它打光和拍摄。伪装 Vancouver 最有效的办法之一，就是夜里用浅景深拍。这样才不会重蹈《红番区》的覆辙——镜头朝北，雪山看得清清楚楚。只要改变角度和灯光，同一个外景地能拍出的东西相当惊人。

cues.en: This is the Orpheum Theater, on a tripod from a high angle. And here's the exact same entryway, from a low angle, handheld. Last but not least, there's the VFX team, who composite specific elements into the shot. Sometimes it's a landmark, like Alcatraz, the Transamerica Pyramid, or the Space Needle. But other times, they'll change almost the entire frame. This is Front Street, playing Japan. And here it is again, playing Future Chicago. And it's all these little details that help us believe the illusion.
cues.zh: 这是 Orpheum Theater，用三脚架从高角度拍。而这是同一个入口，低角度、手持拍摄。最后同样重要的是 VFX 团队，他们把特定元素合成进镜头。有时是地标，比如 Alcatraz、Transamerica Pyramid 或 Space Needle。但另一些时候，他们会改掉几乎整个画面。这是 Front Street，扮演日本。同样这里，又扮演未来的 Chicago。正是这些细枝末节，让我们相信这个幻觉。

cues.en: so that a character can jump out of a window in Vancouver, and in the space of one cut, end up in San Francisco. But what does it mean for a city if it's always playing somewhere else? Well, for Vancouver, it means that our on-screen image is kind of generic. What you've seen in the movies is mostly downtown, like the glass buildings along Barard Street, and the area around Gastown, like this alley off Canby. The city is kind of like one giant backlot, a bunch of anonymous buildings that can stand in for anywhere else.
cues.zh: 这样角色就能从温哥华的一扇窗户跳出去，在一个剪辑之间，落到旧金山。但一座城市如果总是扮演别的地方，这意味着什么？对温哥华来说，这意味着我们的银幕形象有点泛化。你在电影里看到的多半是市中心，比如 Barard Street 沿街的玻璃建筑，还有 Gastown 周边，比如 Canby 旁边的这条小巷。这座城市就像一个巨大的外景片场，一堆毫无特色的建筑可以冒充任何地方。

cues.en: Even when the movies do go somewhere unique, they have a way of typecasting it. For instance, BCIT's aerospace campus actually looks pretty cool. But it's always turned into some vaguely dystopian government facility. Everybody walks around waving a special badge, and they try to maintain order, but of course they can't. Vancouver's locations are like weirdly familiar character actors. For instance, the city's two biggest universities play opposite roles on screen. SFU, with its concrete staircases, never plays a university.
cues.zh:
即使电影真的去了某个独特的地方，它们也总有办法把它类型化。
比如，BCIT 的航空航天校区其实看起来挺酷。
但它总被拍成某种隐约反乌托邦的政府设施。
人人都晃着特殊证件走来走去，想维持秩序，当然维持不了。
温哥华的取景地就像些莫名眼熟的性格演员。
比如，这座城市最大的两所大学在银幕上扮演相反的角色。
SFU 有混凝土楼梯，却从不演大学。

cues.en: It's either a military base or some evil corporation. Meanwhile, UBC always plays a university. That's located everywhere else but Canada. This year, it even played Washington State U, which means that Vancouver, British Columbia finally got to play... I'm deeply moved. Vancouver, Washington. For me, this is the single worst moment in local film history. I will never forgive this.
cues.zh: 它要么是军事基地，要么是某家邪恶公司。与此同时，UBC 总是扮演大学。而那所大学位于除加拿大以外的任何地方。今年，它甚至扮演了 Washington State U，这意味着 Vancouver, British Columbia 终于演到了……我深受感动。Vancouver, Washington。对我来说，这是本地电影史上最糟糕的一刻。我永远不会原谅这件事。

cues.en: But if filmmaking today is global, why do so many of our stories take place in the same four cities? Is it just so we can destroy the same landmark over and over and over? By the way, take a guess where all four of these films were shot. Who wants to go to Vancouver? Sometimes I wonder if local film crews try to sneak the city into the shot as a form of protest. To Hollywood, Vancouver is a location but not a setting. It's a place with talent and scenery and tax incentives.
cues.zh: 但如果今天的电影制作是全球性的，为什么我们的故事有那么多都发生在同样的四座城市？难道只是为了让我们一遍又一遍又一遍地摧毁同一个地标？顺便猜猜，这四部电影都是在哪儿拍的。谁想去 Vancouver？有时我会想，本地剧组是不是想把这城市偷偷塞进镜头，作为一种抗议。对 Hollywood 来说，Vancouver 只是一个拍摄地点，而不是故事背景。那是个有人才、有风景、还有税收优惠的地方。

cues.en: but almost no film identity of its own. Just other identities it can borrow. But maybe there's some hope. For 50 years, there's been a local movement of films and TV shows where Vancouver does play itself. We had no idea how to make a film. We had no idea. We just went ahead and made the film. A lot of these films aren't widely distributed, but they offer a completely different perspective. For me, they're often a lot closer to my own experiences. Ready? As a child of immigrants who mostly explored the city on foot.
cues.zh: 但几乎没有什么属于自己的电影身份。只能借用其他身份。不过也许还有希望。50年来，一直有一场本地电影和电视运动，让温哥华真正扮演自己。我们根本不知道该怎么拍电影。完全不知道。我们就直接上手把电影拍了出来。这些电影很多发行不广，但它们提供了完全不同的视角。对我来说，它们常常更接近我自己的经历。准备好了吗？作为一个移民的孩子，我大多靠步行探索这座城市。

cues.en: These movies treat Vancouver not as a location, but as a setting. And they capture the things that are unique to us. So we need these images more than ever. Because films can preserve a particular time and place. Not as a documentary, but as a fictional story about the real world. And the city deserves better than the occasional joke about its weather. So this is Vancouver, the third biggest filmmaking town in North America.
cues.zh: 这些电影不把温哥华当成取景地，而是把它当成故事背景。它们捕捉到了我们独有的东西。所以我们比以往任何时候都更需要这些影像。因为电影能留住特定的时间和地点。不是以纪录片的方式，而是作为关于真实世界的虚构故事。这座城市值得更好的呈现，而不是偶尔被拿天气开个玩笑。这就是温哥华，北美第三大电影制作之城。

cues.en: On screen, it is ubiquitous, and it is invisible. But off screen, there are other angles just waiting to be filmed. And I think it's time we made a real push to create new images of ourselves. Because honestly, it's our city. Who else is gonna do it?
cues.zh: 在屏幕上，它无处不在，却又看不见。但在屏幕之外，还有其他角度正等着被拍摄。我觉得是时候真正发力，创造我们自己的新形象了。因为说实话，这是我们的城市。不然还能是谁来做呢？
